title: Intercession
definition: Intercession is praying to God on behalf of others, bringing their needs, burdens, salvation, suffering, and growth before Him.
summary: Intercession is loving prayer for others before God.
christFocus: Jesus is the perfect intercessor who lives to pray for His people before the Father.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Intercession is the practice of standing in prayer for others. It brings people before God with compassion, faith, and dependence on His mercy.

Believers intercede for the lost, the suffering, leaders, churches, enemies, the sick, the weak, and fellow disciples. Intercession is not control over outcomes; it is trust in the God who hears and acts wisely.

Christ's intercession gives the deepest confidence. He lives to intercede for His people, and the Spirit also helps believers in weakness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often say they care but never bring others before God. Intercession matters because love prays, and prayer confesses that only God can save, heal, guide, and sustain.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Create a real prayer list and pray for specific people by name. Ask God for their salvation, healing, growth, protection, and obedience.
